title: Reaction palette
description: Choose a reaction without covering the message being discussed.
useCase: Choose a reaction without covering the message being discussed.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Original typographic reaction symbols, not an emoji asset set. Selection remains local.
look: Pale lilac background with a white chat bubble, a small pill reaction button and a white rounded pill of five muted-colour typographic symbols.
motion: Clicking fades in the palette as it settles from 96% scale and 5 px up in 180 ms; symbols rise in 18 ms apart and lift 3 px on hover.
adapt: The open state is `reaction-options` toggled by `data-open` (opacity plus translate and scale, 180 ms), with per-button `transitionDelay` of `i * 18` ms. Replace `reactions`, `labels` and the `quote` bubble; keep the `inert` popover and focus return to `trigger`.
